parameters.description: Amount of time, in milliseconds, that the method will wait for the next video vertical blank before timing out. If this parameter is 0, the method waits 3 times the value specified in the dwMicrosecondsPerField member of the DDVIDEOPORTDESC .
parameters.name: dwTimeout

statements.value_raw: Windows CE 2.12 and later. Version 2.12 requires DXPAK 1.0 or later.
